lines.text: The LORD spoke from the Tent of Meeting, saying a burnt offering from the herd must be an unblemished male.
Priests splatter the blood on the altar, and a flock burnt offering is slaughtered on the south side.
A bird burnt offering must be a turtledove or a young quail, and the priest does not divide it completely.
A grain offering is fine flour with oil and frankincense, and every one must be seasoned with salt.
The peace offering's fat, kidneys and liver lobe are burned, and the LORD forbids eating any fat or blood.
